recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a hooded man whose face is partially transformed into a skull, flanked by large, glowing red stencil-style letters against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: The hood frames the face, creating a central focal point.
The large red letters flank the central figure, creating a symmetrical triptych-style layout.
The skull transformation on the left side of the face mirrors the placement of the first large letter.
The red glow of the typography contrasts sharply with the desaturated, cold tones of the skin.
coreInvariants: Vibrant red accent color for all text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale portrait occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the central figure, specifically the transition point between skin and bone.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the glowing red letters on the left, across the face, to the letters on the right, then down to the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounding the central composition to enhance the 'void' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated grey and pale flesh tones for the central figure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated blood-red for typography and subtle atmospheric glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black background and the highlights on the face; high saturation contrast between the red text and the monochromatic subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Large display letters use a stencil-cut aesthetic with rough, spray-painted edges.
Bottom text uses a condensed, blocky sans-serif with distressed, eroded textures.
All text features a soft red outer glow to simulate backlighting or neon.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'A' display characters feature exaggerated slab serifs and a weathered, hand-cut appearance.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between massive stencil display letters and small, clean condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rough, industrial stencil look of the display letters.
Provides the necessary blocky, condensed structure for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, desaturated portrait of a man in a dark hoodie against a black background. One half of his face is rendered as a realistic human skull. Lighting is dramatic and top-down.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large red stencil letters on either side of the head, slightly tucked behind the hood. Add a horizontal line of red condensed text at the bottom. Apply a subtle red glow and grunge texture to all text.

verificationChecks: Is the skull transition seamless and anatomically aligned?
Does the red text have a soft atmospheric glow?
Are the large letters placed symmetrically?

adjustableVariables: Amount of grunge texture on the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
Unique hand-drawn imperfections in the stencil letters
Exact placement of the skull's teeth

avoid: Soft or blurry focus on the face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text is legible despite the texture.
Check that the hood does not blend too much into the black background.
Verify the skull half looks integrated into the skin, not like a mask.
Confirm the red glow doesn't wash out the facial details.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central desaturated figure + Symmetrical large stencil typography + Red/Black color palette + Distressed textures.
